vizinhos.31: And it came to pass, after he had buried him, that he spake to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones:
vizinhos.33: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places: whosoever would, he consecrated him, and he became one of the priests of the high places.

anteriores.texto: Depois de enterrá-lo, o profeta idoso disse aos filhos: “Quando eu morrer, enterrem-me no túmulo em que o homem de Deus está enterrado; coloquem meus ossos junto aos ossos dele,
pois certamente se cumprirá a palavra que ele clamou pela palavra do SENHOR contra o altar em Betel e contra todas as casas dos lugares altos nas cidades de Samaria.”
